name: Harbor View
about: Sam, a courier, and Biscuit the dog are trapped on the 9th floor of an old apartment block.
tagline: Trapped on the 9th floor with my dog

film.title: Trapped on the 9th Floor With My Dog
film.intro: My name is Sam. When the sirens started, I was alone on the ninth floor of Harbor View with my dog, Biscuit. These are all fifteen days, from the first night to the last.
film.outro: That was my story, all fifteen days of it. Thank you for staying until the end. A new story has already begun on Outbreak Diary.

name: Dead Air
about: Wren, the night host of a hilltop radio station, learns that every word she says on air is shouted over Port Ellis by the old roof speakers, and the infected follow sound.
tagline: Every word I say on the radio calls them

name: Floor 41
about: Maya, a young architect, is trapped on the 41st floor of a glass skyscraper with a night guard.
tagline: Trapped on the 41st floor of a skyscraper

film.title: Trapped on the 41st Floor of a Skyscraper
film.intro: My name is Maya. The night it started, I was working late on the forty-first floor of Meridian Tower. This is everything I recorded, all twelve days of it.
film.outro: That was my story, all twelve days. Thank you for staying until the end. A new story has already begun on Outbreak Diary.

name: Pine Hollow
about: Nora, a park ranger, and her niece Ava hide in a lake cabin while the outbreak spreads through the woods.
tagline: Hiding in a lake cabin with my niece

film.title: Hiding in a Lake Cabin With My Niece
film.intro: My name is Nora. I'm a park ranger. When the outbreak reached the woods, my niece Ava and I hid in a cabin by the lake. These are the pages I wrote, all eleven days.
film.outro: That was our story, all eleven days of it. Thank you for staying until the end. A new story has already begun on Outbreak Diary.

name: Outbreak Specials
label: SPECIAL
about: One-night zombie stories, complete in a single part. A new one every Tuesday.
